brief: A luminous, disc-shaped object hovers over a field of corn stalks. Beneath the craft, two intense beams of bright cyan light illuminate a glowing semicircle on the ground. The light does not remain constant; instead, the beams pulse rapidly and irregularly, casting shifting patterns of vivid cyan across the upright stalks of the corn. The entire scene is perpetually active, displaying the intense pulsing light show without requiring any interaction from the viewer.

The work creates an immersive, constantly shifting visual experience through the interplay of geometric forms and animated lighting effects.
